Repeated checkpoint/trial selection can overfit finite validation data, making the winning score optimistic ([Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)). For this protocol, use paired, within-category user bootstraps: resample 200 users with replacement per category, preserve each user’s paired model outcomes and fixed candidates, then average the four category HR@10 differences equally. Report category deltas and a macro confidence interval. This estimates user-sampling uncertainty conditional on seed 42, trained models and candidates; it excludes training/negative-sampling variability and does not correct adaptive selection bias. Prespecify checkpoint frequency, stopping, trial budget, selection and tie-breaking; retain every trial and compare learning curves at equal cumulative GPU-seconds, including failed trials. These are protocol recommendations, not guarantees of unbiased generalization.

Keep the pinned 99-negative evaluator unchanged. Sampled ranking metrics can reverse full-catalog model rankings ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)). Evaluate training-only popularity and last-item transition controls on identical candidates; add order-agnostic recent-history controls and popularity/history-length breakdowns to investigate shortcuts. Separately report full-catalog unseen-item coverage, recommendation popularity, concentration and inter-user overlap for the 20 training users. These are descriptive diagnostics with limited representativeness, not held-out accuracy or evidence of user satisfaction.

History deletion demonstrates sensitivity to a particular perturbation. It changes information availability, length, recency and potentially input distribution simultaneously; inference-time deletion and retraining after deletion answer different questions. Neither establishes causal preference recovery, meaningful long-range reasoning, reduced conformity, or superior generalization. Sequence-order experiments illustrate why controlled comparisons matter ([dataset analysis](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-2955/paper8.pdf)). Unobserved diversity/conformity traits remain unidentifiable; stronger mechanism claims require matched controls and targeted ablations, with generalization assessed only by the host’s sealed final evaluation.
